retrieved_window_utc: 2026-11-17 ~16:05-16:25 UTC (platform page-fetch tool; per-call times are not logged by the tool, so every game carries the window)
retrieval_method: platform page-fetch tool (fetch_page) reading the official NBA gamebook PDF at statsdmz.nba.com. The tool returns the PDF as text; the PDF bytes cannot be stored from this environment (bash egress to statsdmz.nba.com returns HTTP 000). Every row below therefore carries the gamebook URL it was read from, and every game is re-checked with the arithmetic gates in nba2/v5/check.py.
notes: status is null for a player who played; otherwise it is the official designation printed in the minutes column (DNP - Coach's Decision, DND - ..., NWT - ...).
